about_the_game:
Monster Assets Compatible with Both Front and Side View – This Time, the theme is “Insects”!

From Mono96 Games Lab., the team also active in RPG creation, comes a versatile illustration pack designed to enrich your projects!

These monsters are a little unusual and strike a more niche, “core” theme, so we hope you’ll watch, use, and enjoy them as they bring color to your game.

◆ Features

This is a set of enemy graphic assets with the following highlights:

・Two-Way Support: Front & Side View

Each enemy comes in both Front View and Side View versions.

This versatility greatly expands how you can implement them—making it the defining feature of this pack.

・A Total of 72 Assets!

Includes original data (approx. 900×900px), additional variations with/without ground shadows (Side View only), and resized data optimized for RPG Maker series—ready to be used immediately in your project.

◆ Included Monsters

Black Elephant Weevil (Adult + Core Nardnella Crystal)

Black Elephant Weevil (Child + Nardnella Crystal)

Swallowtail Butterfly (Thunder Element)

Large Vein Butterfly (Water Element)

Crimson Swallowtail (Fire Element)

Tardigrade (Normal Mode)

Tardigrade (Invincible [Hibernation] Mode)

Giant Mantis (+ Parasitic Horsehair Worm)

Rhinoceros Beetle

Stag Beetle

Bonus:

Infested Rhinoceros Beetle

Infested Stag Beetle

*******************************************

◆ Content Details

10 enemies × 2 patterns (Front View / Side View)

Bonus: 2 enemies × 2 patterns (Front View / Side View)

= 24 variations total

Resized versions (S) × 24

With ground shadow (original size) × 12

With ground shadow (Side View ver.) × 12

Total: 72 assets included!

*******************************************

◆ Asset Sizes

Original size: 900×900px

Optimized for RPG Maker MV / MZ (resized versions included)

-----

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
